chapter: Bunk Johnson and the New Orleans scene
title: Cuckoo Chalmers, white musicians, and crossing the color line
summary: He recalls neighbor Cuckoo Chalmers, how little Black players knew white musicians, a few names, and people passing across the color line.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
